name: LegalZoom
description: AI-powered document review meets attorney guidance. Connect to LegalZoom for real-time scans of legal documents to identify critical risks and important clauses, advise on when to engage an attorney, and share notes in advance—all within one workflow. When matters require professional expertise, users will be routed directly into LegalZoom's network of vetted attorneys for timely, jurisdiction-specific guidance. From contract questions to small business matters, LegalZoom helps users get the right support quickly and securely.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LegalZoom to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LegalZoom to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.legalzoom.com/mcp/claude/v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LegalZoom MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LegalZoom provides these MCP tools: check-attorney-consultation-entitlements, get_consultation_topics, get_valid_locations, get_attorney_availability, request_attorney_review, attach_document_to_attorney_review, prepare_document_upload, and add-bap-to-cart.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LegalZoom?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LegalZoom in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
LegalZoom requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LegalZoom is developed by LegalZoom. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
